svg.text: One dial, three constants: where the lift 1 + kx goes as x runs from 0
at x = 1 the lift is e
imaginary dial k = i: stays on the circle,
halfway round at x = π, home at x = 2π
mixed dial k = 0.06 + i: a spiral
(grows and turns: the size is not kept)
real part of the dial k
everything off the two axes: spirals
sign of Im k = which way round
